schemaNotes.milestone: save_milestone accepts project, id, name?, description?, targetDate?: string|null. targetDate:null removes the fixed milestone date.
schemaNotes.moveIssue: save_issue accepts id (UUID or RND identifier), project?, milestone?. Omit status/assignee/labels/parent fields to preserve them.
schemaNotes.createIssue: save_issue without id creates an issue; team and title are required. project, milestone, description, labels, state, relatedTo and blocks are available.
schemaNotes.updateProject: save_project accepts id, summary?, patch?. A prepend patch preserves existing historical description.
schemaNotes.releaseGate: save_issue with a prepend patch preserves older acceptance/history. Creating the epic with blocks:[RND-208 UUID] adds the new dependency without replacing the gate's existing blocking issues.
schemaNotes.noMilestoneArchive: The discovered save_milestone schema has no archived/completed/status field. Retain 0.1.9 as an absorbed historical bucket with its targetDate cleared; do not invent a status field.

## Combined 0.2.0 plan — September 22, 2026

The owner requests one larger release combining the remaining 0.1.9 and selected 0.2.0 work with a complete application visual overhaul. The current public baseline is [v0.1.8](https://github.com/rndaom/execs/releases/tag/v0.1.8), published September 21, 2026 at 02:26:18 UTC. The former October 1 checkpoint is tentative pending the owner's visual direction choice and an implementation/qualification estimate. No separate 0.1.9 tag is planned. This expands the former feature budget, but does not automatically select the optional execs-candidate pool or release development-only Inventory.

## Selected scope

Carry all 14 existing selected records: [RND-246](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-246/clear-stale-update-offers-when-a-later-check-reports-no-update), [RND-290](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-290/show-an-actionable-startup-error-when-durable-maintenance-preflight), [RND-291](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-291/keep-each-settings-pane-at-a-predictable-scroll-position), [RND-292](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-292/make-meaningful-helper-and-status-text-meet-minimum-contrast), [RND-294](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-294/correct-installer-platform-and-casual-compatibility-claims-in-player), [RND-325](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-325/audit-execs-windows-polling-for-periodic-tf2-frame-stalls), [RND-251](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-251/run-the-cumulative-windows-and-linux-functional-release-matrix-before), [RND-213](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-213/delete-profiles-safely-from-the-profile-menu), [RND-214](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-214/add-app-settings-for-updates-motion-install-location-and-support), [RND-202](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-202/replace-shared-preloader-selections-with-the-target-profile-during), [RND-274](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-274/switch-local-only-particle-profiles-without-requiring-the-default-mod), [RND-215](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-215/enforce-one-hud-per-profile-across-replacement-import-switch-and), [RND-324](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-324/make-the-execs-tf2-preload-hook-startup-safe), [RND-208](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-208/validate-and-publish-020-after-the-functional-fixes-and-profile). Add the whole-app overhaul epic covering complete screenshot/state audit, three comparable image-generated directions across every pane, owner selection, a documented visual/motion system, implementation and native qualification. Preserve work states and existing acceptance criteria.

The seven incoming 0.1.9 records are startup/update state, scroll, contrast, documentation, performance investigation and cumulative qualification. Existing 0.2.0 scope retains safe profile deletion, global app settings, single-HUD lifecycle, profile-owned preloader migration/switch/recovery and startup safety, plus the release gate. Creator ZIP review (0.1.6), Files workspace/Hotfix 2 (0.1.7) and Mods Browse/Installed/Casual organization (0.1.8) are inherited shipped capabilities. Integrate and qualify the 0.1.8 forward-port against minor-track profile-owned preloaders.

## Design acceptance

Audit all 10 production panes, onboarding/profile/import/recovery/update/draft/lock flows, open menus and meaningful alternate selections. Include development Inventory distinctly labeled. Preserve a source/build/viewport/state ledger and explicit native-only gaps. Each of three separately organized directions must cover the same pane/state matrix and compact-window cases, with understated TF2 influence, readable text and focus, purposeful motion and reduced-motion equivalents. A catalog, settings form, visual builder and Files editor may use different layouts within the same visual system. Static concepts do not establish native or animation behavior. Record owner choice before product-wide implementation.

## Release boundaries

The 25 execs-candidate records remain optional and unselected unless separately chosen. Inventory remains development-only. Retain profile/export readability, atomic writes, current write roots, game/Steam locks, truthful progress/recovery, updater identity and both platforms. Final candidate qualification remains RND-251 feeding RND-208, using the latest actual public version for updater/profile compatibility. No screenshots or normal test pass substitutes for required native/Cloud/approved live evidence. Publication follows an authorized release request and the existing signed workflow.

Detailed local plan: docs/design/2026-09-22-overhaul/combined-release-plan.md. Original dates and scope text elsewhere are historical; the current selected scope is the one above.

## Absorbed into 0.2.0 — September 22, 2026

The owner requests one larger 0.2.0 release that combines the remaining 0.1.9 work, selected minor scope and a complete application visual overhaul. This milestone is retained as a historical planning bucket; no separate 0.1.9 release/tag or September 28 deadline is planned.

The seven unfinished records move to the existing 0.2.0 milestone with status, labels, assignee and acceptance preserved: [RND-246](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-246/clear-stale-update-offers-when-a-later-check-reports-no-update), [RND-290](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-290/show-an-actionable-startup-error-when-durable-maintenance-preflight), [RND-291](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-291/keep-each-settings-pane-at-a-predictable-scroll-position), [RND-292](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-292/make-meaningful-helper-and-status-text-meet-minimum-contrast), [RND-294](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-294/correct-installer-platform-and-casual-compatibility-claims-in-player), [RND-325](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-325/audit-execs-windows-polling-for-periodic-tf2-frame-stalls), [RND-251](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-251/run-the-cumulative-windows-and-linux-functional-release-matrix-before). Their startup/update, accessibility/navigation, documentation, performance and cumulative qualification work remains required. Urgent install/updater/data-loss/write-lock fixes may still ship independently when necessary.

Current public baseline: [v0.1.8](https://github.com/rndaom/execs/releases/tag/v0.1.8). The combined release date is tentative pending design selection and estimation. No item is marked Done by this consolidation.

args.title: Redesign execs across every pane and interaction state for 0.2.0
args.description:
The owner requests a complete visual overhaul for the combined 0.2.0 release, preceded by a whole-app visual audit and a choice among three complete image-generated alternatives. The outcome is a polished, professionally finished desktop tool with understated TF2 character and layouts suited to each task.

## Deliverables and acceptance

1. Capture and inspect every production pane and meaningful alternate state: Comfig, Binds, Gameplay, HUD, Crosshair, Viewmodels, Sounds, shipped 0.1.8 Mods, Files and Launch; shell/navigation/profile menus; finder/onboarding; profile import/switch/absorb/repair; save/draft/lock/error/recovery/update states. Include development Inventory distinctly labeled. Cover all materially different control patterns, not every numeric permutation. Maintain source/build/preview/native/viewport/state/artwork provenance and explicit unobserved gaps.
2. Produce three separately organized, comparable image-generated directions using the same pane/state matrix. Each must show multiple relevant states of Comfig, Binds, Gameplay and HUD plus all other panes and global decisions, with full-size images and a comparison gallery. Include planned deletion and app settings flows with clear concept labels. Avoid treating optional candidates or Inventory shipment as selected scope.
3. Give each direction a visual-system sheet and motion treatment: color/contrast, typography, spacing, density, controls, focus/selection, imagery, overlays, feedback, pane/selection/menu/dialog/disclosure transitions and reduced-motion equivalents. Include default 1200×800 and minimum 960×640 layouts. Static images cannot establish actual motion quality or accessibility.
4. Record owner choice/refinement before app-wide product implementation. Document the chosen tokens and rules, build common shell/components, then adapt all pane compositions while preserving distinct jobs. TF2 influence must remain restrained; do not invent game preview assets, metrics, success states, cloud sharing or unsupported account actions.
5. Preserve profile/session drafts, explicit Files Save, source-owned feedback, truthful progress, game/Steam write guards, ownership and recoverable transactions. Validate actual contrast/focus/keyboard behavior, native names/status announcements, resize/zoom/reduced motion and performance. Qualify Windows WebView2 and Linux WebKitGTK on the implementation candidate, not only browser fixtures.
6. Design completion is separate from implementation/release completion. Final candidate gates remain RND-251 and RND-208, with latest-public profile/updater compatibility and required approved live evidence. The old October 1 date is tentative pending selected direction and estimate.

## Baseline and dependencies

Public v0.1.8 is already released. Current inventory development branch is missing its Mods forward-port, so capture shipped Browse/Installed/Casual tasks separately and integrate/qualify them for the minor. Related selected work: [RND-291](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-291/keep-each-settings-pane-at-a-predictable-scroll-position), [RND-292](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-292/make-meaningful-helper-and-status-text-meet-minimum-contrast), [RND-214](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-214/add-app-settings-for-updates-motion-install-location-and-support), [RND-213](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-213/delete-profiles-safely-from-the-profile-menu), [RND-325](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-325/audit-execs-windows-polling-for-periodic-tf2-frame-stalls), [RND-251](https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-251/run-the-cumulative-windows-and-linux-functional-release-matrix-before).

Detailed full pane/state matrix and phased acceptance: docs/design/2026-09-22-overhaul/combined-release-plan.md. Audit/source limits: docs/design/2026-09-22-overhaul/research/surface-inventory.md and research/release-scope.md. No implementation, issue completion, tag or publication is implied by creating this epic.
